title: Task start response
description: 200 response to POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/start. run is true only when the task is now running on the server: moved from claimed to running by this request, or by an earlier one. Otherwise the agent must not run the task: it records that it did not run it and drops it (for example a task cancelled or refused before it started).

state.description: The task's state on the server after this request.

run.description: True when the agent may run the task now (state running).
